note: The official Aniimo wiki doesn't publish a type chart, so this is the community-datamined element matchup matrix — corroborated across AniimoTools, GameWith and MetaBot, which agree on all 81 cells. Multipliers: super-effective 1.6×, neutral 1×, resisted 0.625×. Every element resists its own type (0.625×) except Dark, which hits Dark for 1×. Dual-type targets multiply the two values (up to 2.56× double-weak / ~0.39× double-resist). Re-verify after major balance patches.
